notes.title: Small Visual Polish Update
notes.notes:
This update contains some small updates to improve the games visuals. You can see the new animated effects in action [url=https://youtu.be/L-5SYYCKYgc?t=31]here[/url].

We'll be releasing a public demo for Locator in early January, we'd love for a new audience to find the demo when it releases so make sure to tell your friends or any content creators who're interested in detective games.

[list]
[*] Added animated elements (fog, water, & stars) to hand drawn maps
[*] Added a custom mouse cursor
[*] Added letters and missing poster to desk
[*] Adjusted the visuals of the background desk
[/list]

notes.title: Qualty of Life Update
notes.notes:
This update adds some general quality of life improvements, updated art for the first map seen in the game, and some small visual flourishes. Big thank you to everyone that's played the game and provided feedback, it's been incredibly helpful!

If you enjoyed Locator and would like to support the game please wishlist the game and share it with your fav content creators. I'm looking to spread the word and reaching out to relevant content creators now, but it's always best if they hear it from their audience. Any help spreading the word is always appreciated, thanks!

[list]
[*] Added the ability to zoom in on photos (Work in Progress)
[*] Updated the art of the first map (Artwork by [url=https://www.artstation.com/arnocob]Arnaud Caubel[/url])
[*] Updated the main menu with a new image and animation
[*] Added animated dust and light rays
[*] Updated the in-game Wishlist button
[*] Added a confirmation popup before opening up the Feedback Survey/Hints Page in the player's web browser
[*] Misc quality of life changes to the UI
[/list]

notes.title: Quality of Life + Bugfixes Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, this is a small update with QoL improvements and bugfixes. Thanks so much for all of your feedback and spreading the word about the game, it's been incredibly helpful!

If you enjoyed your time with the game please make sure to wishlist Locator- it helps a ton with visibility on Steam. If you want to go the extra mile, you can always share/recommend the game to content creators or relevant communities. Thanks!

[b]Quality of Life:[/b]
[list]
[*] Can now click to progress the tutorial popups (instead of having to wait for them to finish)
[*] Added on-screen UI for the keyboard controls
[*] Updated Main Menu Background & Logo
[*] Updated the in-game background behind the map
[*] Added a volume setting for Photo Ambience
[/list]

[b]Bugfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug which prevented audio settings from applying
[*] Can no longer change Photobook pages in the middle of the reveal of new photos
[*] Fixed an issue which sometime required players to click twice on UI elements to interact with them
[/list]

[b]Known Issues:[/b]
[list]
[*] Continuing a saved game will show the intro text again (but your progress will be saved)
[*] In-game keyboard icons will not update if you change your keybindings in the settings
[*] Photobook can be open/closed in the middle of the reveal of new photos
[/list]
